domains.name: CONTENT-MOD
domains.description: Share of platform content moderation detection, flagging, or enforcement actions handled by automated systems before or without human review.

sub_indicators.name: Meta Automated Detection
sub_indicators.transform: Proactive rate weighted by content actioned across Facebook and Instagram (13 policy areas each), excluding Fake Accounts (no proactive rate from 2026) and Spam, from the official CSV CSER-2026_Q2.csv. The same method gives 94.5 for Q3 2025; the 2026 Q2 input (95.2) could not be reproduced from the CSER data.

sub_indicators.name: YouTube Automated Flagging
sub_indicators.transform: Removed videos first detected by automated flagging: 11,005,420 of 11,159,676 (98.6%). Corrects the 2026 Q2 input (99.5%), which was the automated share of comment removals for Jul-Sep 2023; the video share for Jul-Sep 2025 was 97.9%.

sub_indicators.name: TikTok Automated Enforcement
sub_indicators.transform: Published share of violating content actioned by automated systems without human review; the report template (8_automated_means) gives 94.0% as a cross-check.

domains.name: ALGO-TRADE
domains.description: Financial-market automation score combining FX electronic trading share with current buy-side internal-AI trade-execution adoption.

domains.name: CODE-GEN
domains.description: Share of software engineering output, workflow reliance, and agentic task delegation substantially influenced by AI coding systems.

sub_indicators.name: AI-Generated Code Output Share
sub_indicators.transform: 0.65 x Sonar 2026 committed-code share (42%, fieldwork October 2025) + 0.35 x GitLab 2026 code-source share (34%, published November 2025, fieldwork not stated). GitLab: https://about.gitlab.com/resources/developer-survey/

sub_indicators.name: Technical Work AI Value Share
sub_indicators.transform: (m - 1) / m with the median self-reported March 2026 value multiplier m = 2.

sub_indicators.name: AI Workflow Reliance
sub_indicators.transform: 0.70 x DORA 2025 moderate-to-heavy reliance (65%) + 0.30 x JetBrains AI Pulse January 2026 specialized AI tool adoption (74%). JetBrains: https://blog.jetbrains.com/research/2026/04/which-ai-coding-tools-do-developers-actually-use-at-work/

sub_indicators.name: Agentic Task Delegation
sub_indicators.transform: 0.50 x Anthropic 2026 fully delegable task range midpoint (10%) + 0.50 x GitHub coding-agent adoption midpoint for older projects (29.675%: conservative 26.46% to high 32.89%, traces from 2025-01-01 to early April 2026; arXiv:2606.07448, a rerun of arXiv:2601.18341 by the same authors). Anthropic: https://resources.anthropic.com/hubfs/2026%20Agentic%20Coding%20Trends%20Report.pdf?hsLang=en

sub_indicators.name: Tool Ecosystem Reach
sub_indicators.transform: Sum of install counts for 5 tracked AI coding extensions, in millions; log-scaled over 1M-200M.

domains.name: SUPPORT
domains.description: Share of customer support cases, deflection, production communications agents, and mature support operations involving AI systems.

sub_indicators.name: Bot Deflection Rate
sub_indicators.transform: Held from the prior locked Intercom value; the source definition (no escalation vs customer-confirmed resolution) is unresolved.

domains.name: CREDIT
domains.description: Degree of AI involvement in credit underwriting and lending decisions, with platform automation adjusted by product-market denominators.

sub_indicators.name: AI-Underwritten Personal Loan Proxy
sub_indicators.transform: Upstart share of loans fully automated (91% in Q1 and Q2 2026, Form 10-Q) x TransUnion fintech share of unsecured personal-loan originations (42%, Q3 2025, Q4 2025 CIIR: https://newsroom.transunion.com/q4-2025-ciir/). The Q2 2026 CIIR fintech share is not stated in TransUnion's published text, so the denominator is held; the window reflects the older factor.

sub_indicators.name: AI Credit Decisioning (Banks)
sub_indicators.transform: Share of euro-area significant institutions (110) using AI for credit scoring in 2024 supervisory reporting (ECB Supervision Newsletter, Chart 1). Corrects the 2026 Q2 input (20%), which was the share of 24 North American credit-risk chiefs with at least one generative-AI use case (October 2023), not credit-decisioning deployment. Geography differs from the indicator's original U.S. framing.

domains.name: MEDICAL-DX
domains.description: AI involvement in clinical diagnosis and imaging, combining FDA-cleared AI device capacity, imaging AI adoption, physician assistive-diagnosis use, and pathology adoption.

sub_indicators.name: FDA AI-Enabled Medical Devices
sub_indicators.transform: Row count of the FDA AI-enabled device list CSV (content current as of 2026-09-04; final decisions through 2026-06-29), downloaded 2026-10-17; normalized linearly over 0-2000 devices.

sub_indicators.name: Pathology AI Adoption
sub_indicators.transform: Conservative hold pending a representative clinical deployment source; 2024/2025 pathology surveys show uneven and mostly non-diagnostic use.

domains.name: LEGAL-AI
domains.description: AI adoption and workflow use in legal research, document review, and legal work, anchored by organization surveys and document-review evidence.

sub_indicators.name: Legal Organization GenAI Adoption
sub_indicators.source: Thomson Reuters AI in Professional Services

sub_indicators.name: Solo and Small Firms Using AI for Legal Work
sub_indicators.source: Clio Solo and Small Law Firms 2026

data_sources.name: Thomson Reuters AI in Professional Services
Clio Solo and Small Law Firms

domains.name: HIRE
domains.description: AI involvement in talent acquisition, combining organization adoption, screening use-case adoption, broad process coverage, and assessment platform reach.

sub_indicators.name: Orgs Using AI in Talent Acquisition
AI Assessment Platform Reach
sub_indicators.transform: Single-vendor annualized platform volume (HireVue Q1 2024); normalized linearly over 0-300M per year.

data_sources.name: SHRM State of AI in HR 2026
HireVue 2026 Global AI in Hiring Report

domains.name: EDUCATION
domains.description: AI influence across student schoolwork, assessment and grading, teacher workflow, and AI-written student output.

sub_indicators.name: AI-Graded Assessments
sub_indicators.transform: Held from the prior locked Gradescope/Turnitin value; no direct grading-automation source has been verified.

analysis_runs.label: 2024 published baseline
analysis_runs.notes: Archived published baseline from the original scoring series; retained for audit but not used in the headline comparison.

analysis_runs.label: 2024 recalculated history
analysis_runs.notes: Backcast using the 2026 scoring frame. Source-level coverage is limited; 2024 values preserve the original 2024-to-2025 domain movement from the recalculated 2025 anchor.

analysis_runs.label: 2025 published baseline
analysis_runs.notes: Archived March 2026 publication baseline from the original scoring series; retained for audit but not used as the headline prior after the 2026 source refresh.

analysis_runs.label: 2025 recalculated baseline
analysis_runs.notes: Recalculated with the 2026 source and scoring rules so the 2026 update is compared using the same measuring stick. The archived March 2026 published score was 46.0 under the prior scoring series.

analysis_runs.label: 2026 Q2 source refresh
analysis_runs.notes: 2026 source refresh in the recalculated public series. Algorithmic trading is scored from BIS FX electronic execution and Coalition Greenwich internal-AI trade-execution adoption rather than broad market-automation proxies. Code-gen uses a five-input output share, value share, workflow reliance, agentic delegation, and tool reach method.

analysis_runs.label: 2026 Q4 source refresh
analysis_runs.notes: Semiannual source refresh under the frozen v2 method. Refreshes content moderation (Meta, YouTube and TikTok 2026 reports), the FDA AI-enabled device count, GitHub coding-agent traces, and VS Code installs. Corrects two mis-sourced 2026 Q2 inputs (YouTube comment-removal share, bank credit decisioning); about +0.4 of the +0.5 change since 2026 Q2 comes from those corrections.
